source.title: Common English words chosen for each age group (starter list). Meanings and sentences are original to this project.
source.license: Reference only (the page describes the kind of list this was modelled on). No list was copied: words, meanings and sentences were written for this project and are released with it.

words.meaning: needed, something you must have
words.sentence: It is necessary to wear a seatbelt.
words.tip: One collar and two sleeves: one c and two s.

words.meaning: kept apart, not joined together
words.sentence: Sort the recycling into separate bins.

words.meaning: without any doubt
words.sentence: It will definitely rain tomorrow.

words.meaning: the natural world and surroundings
words.sentence: Plastic waste harms the environment.

words.meaning: the people who run a country
words.sentence: The government announced a new law.

words.meaning: what you know through learning
words.sentence: Knowledge grows when you ask questions.

words.meaning: a chart of the days and months of a year
words.sentence: The exam is marked on the calendar.

words.meaning: to make someone feel awkward or ashamed
words.sentence: Please do not embarrass your brother.

words.meaning: a special event or time
words.sentence: Her birthday is a special occasion.

words.meaning: a place where you pay for a meal
words.sentence: The restaurant is busy on Fridays.

words.meaning: to provide room or space for
words.sentence: The hall can accommodate two hundred people.

words.meaning: a person who handles letters, calls and meetings for an office
words.sentence: The secretary booked the meeting.

words.meaning: a line of people waiting
words.sentence: A long queue formed at the door.

words.meaning: a repeating pattern of beats in music
words.sentence: The drummer kept a steady rhythm.
words.tip: Rhythm Helps Your Two Hips Move.

words.meaning: well known to you
words.sentence: That tune sounds familiar.

words.meaning: a special right or advantage
words.sentence: Voting is a privilege and a responsibility.

words.meaning: a space with no air in it
words.sentence: Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.

words.meaning: playfully naughty
words.sentence: The mischievous puppy hid my shoe.

words.meaning: a small group chosen to make decisions
words.sentence: The committee met on Monday.
words.tip: Two m's, two t's, two e's.

words.meaning: a firm promise that something will happen
words.sentence: The shop gave a one-year guarantee.

words.meaning: careful and thorough about doing your work
words.sentence: She is a conscientious student.

words.meaning: a system with many rules and officials
words.sentence: Getting the form approved meant fighting the bureaucracy.

words.meaning: made up of different kinds
words.sentence: The box held miscellaneous items.

words.meaning: a person you know slightly
words.sentence: He is an acquaintance, not a close friend.

words.meaning: a person who starts a business
words.sentence: The entrepreneur opened her first shop at nineteen.

words.meaning: a list of questions used to collect information
words.sentence: Please fill in the questionnaire.

words.meaning: careful watching of a person or place
words.sentence: The shop has camera surveillance.

words.meaning: the work of keeping something in good condition
words.sentence: The bridge is closed for maintenance.

words.meaning: the way a word is said aloud
words.sentence: Her pronunciation of French is excellent.

words.meaning: complex and advanced
words.sentence: The robot uses sophisticated sensors.
